source.quote: Progress tokens MUST be a string or integer value
Progress tokens can be chosen by the client using any means, but MUST be unique across all active requests.
The `progress` value MUST increase with each notification, even if the total is unknown.
The `message` field SHOULD provide relevant human readable progress information.

requirements.exclusion: Whether a message is relevant and human readable is a judgment about its meaning, not its shape; any string satisfies the schema, and no mechanical reading of one decides relevance.

source.quote: Progress notifications MUST only reference tokens that: Were provided in an active request; Are associated with an in-progress operation
Clients and servers SHOULD track active progress tokens

requirements.exclusion: Tracking is bookkeeping inside each party. Its wire consequences are the MUST rows beside it, which are judged: a reused token (PROG-002) and progress for a finished request (PROG-005, PROG-008).

source.quote: Both parties SHOULD implement rate limiting to prevent flooding

requirements.exclusion: A rate is messages per unit of time, and checks may not consult time — the limit LIFE-015 records. No count of notifications alone separates a flood from a long operation reporting often.

source.quote: Progress notifications MUST stop after completion
